reviews.title: Scam?
reviews.text: I downloaded this app from Tik Tok and was very intrigued. I’ve been wanting to log my walks and have more motivation so I decided to get it. While I was setting everything up, I had to pay for a subscription. I chose to go ahead and do the $1.00 a week option. After I gave them my information there was a charge for $98.00 on my card. I canceled my subscription and got my money back, but I just thought that was a little sketchy and wanted people to know my experience. I very well could’ve clicked something wrong but I don’t recall reading anything about a $98.00 charge. I will say they did work fast and diligently when giving me my refund.
